description: XFCE's recommended packages that work in a box: themes and icons, thumbnails, notifications, the user folders and X tools (needs a desktop: put Recipes/linux-desktop before it)

steps.name: A desktop is there
steps.run: command -v xfce4-session > /dev/null || { echo 'XFCE is not in this image: put Recipes/linux-desktop before this recipe' >&2; exit 1; }

steps.name: XFCE's recommended packages, less the ones a box must not have or cannot use
steps.run: apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install desktop-base gnome-themes-extra tango-icon-theme librsvg2-common libgtk-3-bin libglib2.0-bin libglib2.0-data shared-mime-info liburi-perl xdg-user-dirs tumbler xfce4-notifyd at-spi2-core dbus-user-session x11-utils xauth xcvt xfonts-base

checks: [ "$(dpkg-query -W -f '${db:Status-Status} ' desktop-base tumbler xfce4-notifyd xdg-user-dirs at-spi2-core dbus-user-session)" = 'installed installed installed installed installed installed ' ] && echo 'themes, thumbnails, notifications, user folders and the accessibility and session buses are installed'

found="$(dpkg-query -W -f '${Package} ${db:Status-Status}\n' light-locker xfce4-screensaver xscreensaver mate-screensaver 2> /dev/null | grep ' installed$')"; if [ -n "$found" ]; then echo "a screen locker is installed, and the box user has no password to unlock it: $found"; exit 1; fi; echo 'no screen locker'
